queries: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS group_average FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.group_average AS amount_above_average, t.avg_modindex / o.group_average AS ratio_to_group_average FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.group_average ORDER BY ratio_to_group_average DESC, t.telescref ASC LIMIT 10;
